headline: Tanzee rifle partner
title: Tanzee | The Rifle Firing Grass Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Did you know a Palworld Pal can fire an assault rifle? Tanzee is a small Grass Pal in Palworld one point zero. Its partner skill, Cheery Rifle, makes it fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time when you activate it. At your base it works at level one in Planting, Handiwork, Gathering, Lumbering and Transporting. Would you use it? Comment below!
description: Tanzee in Palworld 1.0 is a Grass Pal that fires an assault rifle with its partner skill and works five jobs at level one.
